kind: Host-backed atomic scan and committed selected-bundle integration

integration: CLI scan publishes generated bytes at configured output root
Committing pointer and selected bundle enables equal check
Committed selected bundle passes retained validation and SQLite publication
Failed pointer switch preserves prior and reports findings with failure
Corrupt pointer cannot fall back to retained bundle
Mixed flat and selected layout rejects
Retained bundle directories do not change candidate snapshot identity

limitations: Default host configuration and approval loader not implemented
Scan creates output, not Git commits; generated output must be committed for subsequent clean admission
Flat-layout migration requires explicit host action
Working-tree execution, staging cleanup and cross-platform acceptance remain open
Trusted local directory ownership required; no OS sandbox or power-loss guarantee
publication: Local tooling commit only; no remote push or release tag
